official_price_rule: Use only when scanlite fresh=true and generated_at is recent. day_change_pct is previous-close based, not true rolling24h.

scanlite.deep_usable_rule: Detection arrays stay intact. Deep may continue when BTC is fresh and enough actionable liquid candidates exist; final price seal remains mandatory for entry readiness.
scanlite.max_age_note: Informational only: low-liquidity coins can have old last-trade timestamps.

scan.deep_usable_rule: Detection arrays stay intact. Deep may continue when BTC is fresh and enough actionable liquid candidates exist; final price seal remains mandatory for entry readiness.
scan.max_age_note: Informational only: low-liquidity coins can have old last-trade timestamps.

mapping_integrity.rule: Final prices are joined by ticker key only. Never zip candidate and price arrays by index.

final_price_recheck_top15.rule: selected candidates must be rechecked after deep analysis; execution requires each ticker's own final_freshness.fresh=true; abs(scan_to_final_pct)>=1% => price_move_warning
